payload.description_html: From source: General osteostracan headshield anatomy in dorsal view (adapted from Stensiö 1932), landmark configuration, and characters measured. Abbreviations: cor, cornual process; cor.ser, cornual serrations; lat.f, lateral field; med.f, median field; orb, orbit. Landmarks and semi-landmarks: 1, anterior tip of the headshield; 2–5, anterior, posterior, right, and left tips of the orbit; 6–7, anterior and posterior tips of the median field; 8–9, anterior and posterior tips of the lateral field; 10–11, tip and apex of the cornual process; 12–31, curve of the ventral margin of the headshield from the anterior tip to the tip of the cornua.
